title: Choose the visual world
question: Homepage redesign for founders. Motion principles from your glass+sculpture video are pinned on every option. The roll assigned Mission Control Launch Board.

options.label: Mission Control Launch Board
options.lineage: NASA/spacecraft go-no-go boards, T-minus countdown walls, telemetry glass
options.thesis: Your idea is on the pad: a live countdown to a shipped MVP, with glass telemetry cards orbiting a metallic payload.
options.viewport: Left: big T-minus / ₹29,999 / 10–14 days as mission readouts. Right: slow-orbiting metallic form with floating glass cards (features, ownership, live). Primary GO = Start Your MVP.
options.risk: Can feel sci-fi theater if the offer numbers are not the loudest instruments on the board.

options.label: Tensegrity Breathing Column
options.lineage: kinetic sculpture / carbon rods and tension cord
options.thesis: The MVP is a structure held by opposing forces: scope in, bloat out—rigid because tension is honest.
options.case: Strong audience ID for craft-aware founders; product clarity loses slightly—price/timeline need pinned force labels or the metaphor eats the offer.
options.viewport: A breathing strut network as hero; WhatsApp CTA as LOCK; inclusions as compression members, exclusions as slack.
options.risk: Engineering beauty can outrank conversion if force labels bury ₹29,999.

options.label: Multiplane Cel Dawn
options.thesis: Scroll sinks the camera through painted depth planes toward a lit cottage—the shipped product waiting in the mist.
options.case: Memorable Experience craft; weaker founder identification and slower path to price/CTA than a launch board.
options.viewport: Banded depth layers; product name on nearest cel; cottage light = live MVP; CTA on the foreground cel.
options.risk: Storybook warmth can soften urgency to ship.

options.label: Midnight Transit Diagram
options.thesis: Zero to MVP is the scarlet express line: stations are days, interchanges are decisions, destination is live product.
options.case: Excellent product clarity for journey/timeline; audience ID solid for operators, slightly cooler for visionary founders.
options.viewport: Full-bleed route diagram; founder origin → LIVE station in 10–14 stops; fare badge ₹29,999; GO rides the chosen line.
options.risk: Map density can crowd the hero if the whole network shows at once.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: Dark premium agency landing: bold headline, glass cards, package grid, WhatsApp CTA—executed at full craft with your pinned motion language.
canonCard.viewport: Hero left copy / right 3D, MVP highlight, three packages, contact banner—the arrangement founders already scan.
canonCard.risk: Familiar category silhouette; wins only on motion and finish.
